mapper.sql: id, skill_name, category, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skills (skill_name, category, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted) VALUES (#{skillName}, #{category}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, FALSE)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM skills WHERE LOWER(skill_name) = #{name} AND is_deleted = FALSE
SELECT FROM skills WHERE is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY LOWER(skill_name)
SELECT FROM skills WHERE is_deleted = FALSE AND id IN #{id}
